sections.label: Child-led therapy, grounded in real life.
text: Child-led therapy, grounded in real life.

Sensphere was founded by a team of paediatric occupational therapists who believe therapy should fit around a child's real life — their classroom, their bedroom, their playground — not the other way round. We look beyond the behaviour to understand the sensory, motor and emotional regulation skills
We work with children and young people aged 2 to 18, alongside parents, carers, teachers and SENCOs, to build practical strategies that stick — at home, at school and in the community.

sections.label: Assessment and therapy, tailored to your child
text: Assessment and therapy, tailored to your child
Every child is different, so every plan starts with listening — to you, your child, and (with your permission) their school.
Comprehensive OT Assessment
A full assessment of motor skills, sensory processing, self-care and daily function, with a detailed written report and practical recommendations.
Sensory Processing Assessment
Standardised sensory profiling to explain sensitivities to noise, touch, movement or textures, and how they affect behaviour and learning.
EHCP & SEND Reports
Independent occupational therapy evidence to support Education, Health and Care Plan applications, annual reviews and tribunals.
1:1 Therapy Programmes
Regular sessions targeting fine and gross motor skills, self-regulation, handwriting or independence in dressing, feeding and toileting.
School-Based Consultancy
Classroom observations, staff training and practical adjustments to help teachers support sensory and motor needs day to day.
Parent & Carer Coaching
Guided sessions to help families understand assessment findings and build calm, workable routines at home.
What we offer

sections.label: Frequently asked questions
text: Frequently asked questions
Do we need a referral to book an assessment?
No. Most families come to us directly without a GP or paediatrician referral, though we're happy to work alongside any professionals already involved with your child.
Where do sessions take place?
We offer assessments and therapy in our clinic rooms, in schools by arrangement, at home for younger children where appropriate, and via secure video call for follow-up and coaching sessions.
How long does an assessment take?
Our comprehensive OT assessment typically takes 90 minutes with your child, followed by a written report within two to three weeks.
Can your reports be used for an EHCP or tribunal?
Yes. Our reports are written to a standard suitable for Education, Health and Care Plan needs assessments, annual reviews and SEND tribunal evidence.
What areas do you cover?
We see families across England and Wales through our clinic and school visits, plus UK-wide via video consultation for coaching and review sessions.
How much does therapy cost?
Fees depend on the type and length of service. We'll always confirm pricing clearly before booking, with no hidden costs.
